measurement: File levels use FFmpeg loudnorm / ebur128. Representative mix uses Chromium OfflineAudioContext with the production output graph, both sliders at 100%, then FFmpeg true-peak/loudness analysis.

representativeMix.scenario: Full 176.14-second BGM; clicks at 10/20/30/60/110/140 seconds, clear at 45 seconds, medal at 90 seconds. BGM gain remains 1 for clicks/medal, 0.3 for clear with exponential recovery. Previous comparison uses the same output graph with +6 dB input; current uses +14 dB. Both sliders 100%. Offline rendered measurement, not OS speaker loudness.

notes: The 120 ms click uses a 400 ms measurement window padded with silence, not long-form integrated loudness.
BGM and UI are the only sustained gameplay audio; integrated mix loudness depends on actual cue timing and user sliders.
Peak targets are ceilings: the medal transient is not exaggerated just to reach -3 dBFS.
Original MP3 files are retained and are not played by the current mix.
